themes.sub_theme: office REIT recovery (West Coast / Sunbelt office)
maturity_signals: HPP 10-Q (filed 2026-11-06, 0001482512-26-000085): asset sales funded the 2026-10-14 repurchase of $100M 3.95% 2027 notes and $100M 5.95% notes -- balance-sheet repair rather than demand recovery
FSP 10-Q (filed 2026-10-27, 0001104659-26-119172): 9.0% TPG term loans with 6.0% OID; expanded strategic review continuing through October 2026 -- distressed-capital terms
adoption_evidence: No filing evidence of leasing demand turning: both issuers are selling assets to delever (HPP held-for-sale Skyport Plaza; FSP sale of a property on 2026-07-08 with proceeds used to repay term loans)

comparable_prior_wave.name: Post-GFC REIT recovery
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Office/real-estate equity priced for insolvency, with deleveraging through asset sales and recapitalization
comparable_prior_wave.different: 2009's driver was the end of a credit freeze for structurally sound assets. Today's driver is secular office demand (remote work) plus high rates, and these names already had their 2009-2019 cycle. Even the best post-GFC leader (SLG) reached about 10x from a deep trough, short of 25x

themes.wave_score_reason: There is a measurable analogue, but primary-filing evidence shows deleveraging and asset sales, not adoption or demand recovery.

themes.sub_theme: levered net-lease, hotel, ground-lease and hospital REITs (refinancing-driven)
maturity_signals: SVC 10-Q (filed 2026-11-04, 0000945394-26-000061): $850M of 2027 notes redeemed in 2026; net lease rent coverage 2.17x
SAFE 10-Q (filed 2026-11-04, 0001095651-26-000035): $1.2B undrawn on the 2024 unsecured revolver
MPT 10-Q (filed 2026-11-06, 0001193125-26-451995): about $1.0B new-note proceeds used to retire the 2026 notes and part of the 2027 notes; notes exchange captured about a $123M discount
adoption_evidence: Refinancings are closing at high coupons (SVC 8.625% 2031 secured, 8.875% 2032 notes per the 10-Q fair-value table) -- access exists but is expensive

comparable_prior_wave.name: Post-GFC REIT recovery (also checked: 2020-03 to 2021 COVID rebound, SVC 3.6x in 15 months, MPT 1.8x)
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Levered REITs priced for refinancing failure
comparable_prior_wave.different: A rate-driven recovery would lift all of them modestly; 25x would need equity tiny against an enterprise value that then recovers -- possible only for the most levered (SVC). The COVID rebound gave SVC 3.6x and MPT 1.8x (tools.py px)

themes.wave_score_reason: A rate/credit-spread recovery is plausible, but it is a leverage trade, not a theme with adoption evidence; prior REIT recoveries topped out at 2-10x.
